about: FR-R3-091 — accepted WCAG 2.1 AA findings, as a COUNT AND A LIST.
A count alone can say something got worse; only a list can say WHICH finding is new.
That is the defect D5 found in the duplicate-authority gate and the one the webview lint
baseline still had. Ratchets in BOTH directions: above is a regression, below is a stale
record that must be rewritten in the same change.
FR-R3-131 — the thirty color-contrast entries are GONE, fixed at the token level, not
re-accepted. This list is now SHRINK-ONLY: tests/lint/a11y-baseline-shrinks.test.ts fails
any change that adds an entry. An accepted finding needs a new dated exception, not a line
appended here. Removing an entry, with the fix in the same change, is the only edit allowed.
Regenerate with: npm run a11y -- --update-baseline (see tests/a11y/README.md).
